limitations: The historical locks record name and version only. No artifact filename, hash, index URL or installer is carried by the historical evidence, so artifact-byte authority is ABSENT for every member without exception.

Transitive relations were computed from the CURRENTLY INSTALLED Requires-Dist metadata in the tactics venv, a local mutable observation. Dependency metadata can differ between the historical artifact and today's, so this is diagnostic evidence, not proof of what was historically required.

Source availability was established by querying one index per package (PyPI, or the PyTorch CPU index for '+cpu' local versions). A successful query proves that source serves the version today; it binds no bytes and proves nothing about other sources.
Provenance for index-served packages rests on a diagnostic query, not on an authority recorded at install time.
This candidate set is sufficient for the J1 static import closure on paper. It has not been built, installed or executed.
